title: Split search finds the solution
statement: For natural numbers $N$ and $i$ satisfying $i+(i+1)=N$, the bounded search for the least $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$ satisfying $j+(j+1)=N$ returns $i$.
replaced: For all $N, i \in \mathbb{N}$ with $i + (i+1) = N$, the bounded search for the least $j \in \{0,\dots,N\}$ satisfying $j + 1\cdot(j+1)^1 = N$ returns exactly $i$.
